going_concern.quote: The report from our independent registered public accounting firm for the year ended September 30, 2024, includes an explanatory paragraph stating that our losses from operations and required additional funding to finance our operations raise substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a goin

financing_terms.equity_line: Until March 1, 2025, we will not be able to sell any securities pursuant to the Current Shelf Registration Statement, including under our current common stock purchase agreement with Lincoln Park Capital Fund, LLC (“Lincoln Park”).
